newsitem.title: USA: Tractor Supply COO Newkirk retires early.
newsitem.headline: Tractor Supply COO Newkirk retires early.

text.p: Tractor Supply Co said Tuesday that Gerald Newkirk has retired as president and chief operating officer, effective today.
The company said Newkirk had originally planned to retire at the end of 1998, but accelerated his plans for personal reasons. He will continue to serve as a director.

The company also said that John Pearson was stepping down, effective today, from his position as senior vice-president of merchandising, but that he has not yet decided whether he will stay with the company.

Joseph Scarlett, chairman and chief executive officer, will assume the duties of both men, said the company, while it takes steps to "reinvigorate its merchandising and marketing efforts and identify qualified successors."
The company said it has recently begun taking steps to rejuvenate its merchandising mix and offer a more focused assortment of products, at greater value.

Tractor Supply is a specialty retailer which supplies the daily farming and maintenance needs of its target customers: hobby, part-time and full-time farmers, as well as suburban customers, contractors and tradesman. It operates 223 stores.
